scope: read-only source audit and native Node import probe; no Hetzner server access

checks.detail: Checked local Node runtime: v24.22.1. Hetzner must separately confirm the selected runtime.
Current Drizzle adapter and transactional operations depend on D1. A native persistent database adapter and migration/restore verification are required.
Private and approved media use R2 bindings. A persistent storage adapter with the same authorization rules is required.

Current start command: node --import ./scripts/sites-env.mjs ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --ip 127.0.0.1 --inspector-port 0

Argon2id currently imports a Worker-compiled WebAssembly module. Verify the native Node build/loader and compatibility with existing password hashes; do not replace hashing or reset accounts to hide a runtime problem.

Current security mail uses the external Resend API; the local test captures synthetic messages. Decide the real mail provider and test its transport. An SMTP provider requires an adapter, not just an SMTP environment variable.

Confirm Hetzner port/socket handoff, trusted client-IP headers and HTTPS forwarding; force password-only AUTH_MODE=local outside Sites and reject forged platform identity headers. Retain CSRF, Secure cookies, MFA and security headers.
The advertised PHP memory_limit is not a Node.js RAM allocation. Node RAM/CPU/process limits require provider confirmation and a native-app load test.
Confirm writable private storage outside the document root, filesystem/locking behavior, database availability, backup location and consistent database restore.
Existing domain, DNS, mail records and website are untouched. No hosting order or deployment was made.

purchaseRecommendation: Do not regard Node.js support alone as a compatibility or capacity confirmation.
